theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: XEG.TO is the only theme with both the absolute-trend gate (eligible) AND high trend-health/durability (0.71), the one validated leg for staying in a shake-out. Its 93% breadth and one-narrative structure justify continuing to own the trend rather than stepping aside — but the crowding flag (z=1.19, crowded=true) is a SIZE-DOWN caution, not a buy signal, and rank-IC has no forward edge, so this is a stay-with-the-trend lean, not a chase.
theses.dissent: Crowding plus one-narrative absorption of only 0.31 means a sharp mean-reversion in energy could hit the whole TSX hard precisely because everything is already long the same theme; the detector's own dir_accuracy of 0.34 says the lean is a coin-flip loser historically.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO lags the S&P/TSX by 8% or more before the 20-trading-day check-by date.

theses.subject: Pipelines & Midstream
theses.thesis: Eligible and trend-positive (hurst tag 'trend', durability_bar 0.71, breadth 0.5) with none of the crowding excess of Oil & Gas (crowding_z 0.58). theses.dissent: It is unscorable with no clean proxy, and a broad one-narrative market may mean any energy-adjacent name is already fully priced by the same leadership flow; the detector provides no validated return edge from rank.
